cause: Context Pack was frozen before development started.
impact: The line has an evidence-bound starting context.
lesson: Freeze the initial context before changing implementation state.

cause: The native Seatbelt backend is root-owned, but the active Workbench virtual environment and package-manager interpreter are user-owned and therefore cannot satisfy the strict C2 immutable-runtime identity policy.
impact: A native canary can validate the OS backend, but formal C2 candidate evaluation cannot honestly trust the current user-owned Python runtime.
lesson: Separate OS-backend availability from immutable evaluator-runtime trust; never promote a local virtual environment to a release C2 identity merely because Seatbelt starts.

cause: C2 hostile-candidate certification was not connected to the Workbench runtime and exceeded the approved local macOS product boundary.
impact: Unused C2 modules and their dedicated tests are removed from v1.7.3; the requirement is retained only for a future deployment, packaged app, plugin, or externally supplied model boundary.
lesson: Do not turn a future hostile-extension certification boundary into current product code before the product imports or executes that boundary.
